what_differs: WagerTech asked for bi-weekly documented release notes once sprints start and Jumpr agreed. No Jira ticket, recurring task or template tracks release notes; later internal syncs (2026-09-21, 2026-09-24) show release notes are still being set up ad hoc (partner/operator release note, Loom per completed feature).
suggested_action: Suggestion only: add a recurring release-notes task (or a Definition of Done line) and record the agreed format (written notes plus Loom per L3042) so the client commitment is visible.
